answer: A durable defense is per-identity stake bonded to verifiable work: each agent must lock a deposit on the ledge of its public record before it can transact, and every completed job adds a signed cipher trail linking results to that single identity. Like an ember that only stays lit while fed, reputation only grows through costly, checkable work, so spawning a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand deposits and a thousand histories — an expense that quickly outweighs any gain from one fraudulent vote or deal.
